**Severity:** warning · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
No route matches "{path}" (routes from {routesDir ?? "the router"}).
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Point the Link at an existing route path (check src/routes), or add the missing route file.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { Link } from "@rivetjs/router/link";
export const A = () => <Link to="/abuot">About</Link>;
```

```tsx prefer
import { Link } from "@rivetjs/router/link";
export const A = () => <Link to="/about">About</Link>;
```

## When it is reported

Reported by the language service and rivet-check, not by the build; a warning. Silent when the Link's to is typed with the generated route union (.rivet/routes.d.ts, written by rivet sync): TypeScript itself then rejects a path that matches no route (TS2820), so run tsc as well; the starters' npm run check is rivet sync && rivet-check && tsc.
